Problem Identification: Predict daily store sales to aid staffing and inventory planning

ML Model features: Pipeline with FunctionTransformer for feature prep; features: Store, DayOfWeek, Customers, Promo, StateHoliday, SchoolHoliday, Open, Year, Month, Day, WeekOfYear; model: RandomForestRegressor (ensemble); confidence interval via per-tree variance
Results: Real metrics written to models/metrics.json after Train/Train-Sync; dashboard displays feature importance from models/feature_importance.json; predictions persisted to SQLite with timestamp and downloadable CSV
Business Impact: Improves workforce planning and inventory control; reduces stockouts/overstaffing; fast self-serve forecasts for operations; explainable via feature importance; lightweight UI for demos and stakeholder reviews
